text:
Produce the full work plan covering all 24 Atlas modules (gateway, alerts, checkout, billing, feed, media, tenant, webhooks, audit, export, search, archive, backup, scheduler, profile, returns, notify, upload, inventory, pricing, shipping, ingest, sync, session), every value, limit, owner, placement, dependency, and file below. Use only these values; earlier drafts are withdrawn.

Values: inventory.queue_depth=280, tenant.queue_depth=50, webhooks.retry_limit=6, webhooks.timeout_s=95, session.ttl_s=480, alerts.batch_size=850, profile.batch_size=500, returns.queue_depth=240, notify.queue_depth=410, upload.queue_depth=500, search.timeout_s=95, search.retry_limit=5, feed.retry_limit=5, archive.timeout_s=85, media.max_workers=26, backup.max_workers=12.

Limits (already met): alerts.queue_depth>=480, export.timeout_s>=115, sync.queue_depth<=20, ingest.max_workers<=2, inventory.max_workers<=4, pricing.retry_limit<=1, profile.ttl_s<=90, shipping.max_workers<=4.

Owners: alpha—audit, backup, search, export; delta—returns, profile; beta—tenant, upload.

Apart: gateway/profile, alerts/checkout, billing/feed, media/tenant. Together: tenant/webhooks, audit/export, search/archive, backup/scheduler.

Deps (A needs B): billing→webhooks, billing→tenant, search→audit, upload→gateway, pricing→shipping, archive→checkout, ingest→export, sync→pricing. Forbidden: checkout→feed, inventory→sync, archive→webhooks, session→webhooks.

Run order: gateway→audit, gateway→shipping, shipping→backup, shipping→session. Optional: gateway.ttl_s≈330, pricing on alpha. Others: your call.

Files: rules.py→returns, locks.py→tenant, bench.py→shipping, handlers.py→sync, specs.py→backup, parser.py→backup, events.py→media, retry.py→gateway.
